title: Local $W^{2,1}_{p}$ convergence of penalization for time-inconsistent stopping problems
summary: This paper studies the penalization method for a general class of time-inconsistent stopping problems. Inspired by some existing results on penalization for optimal stopping problems, we introduce the penalized PDE problem and the penalized control problem for time-inconsistent stopping problems, uncovering some interesting discrepancy stemming from the time-inconsistency.
